source: derived: horizons marched over the global LOLA grid (0.5 degree cells, 30 cells, 24 azimuths); Sun and Earth directions from the JPL DE440 ephemerides every 6 h of 2027
note: Longest stretch of 2027 without the Sun above the regional horizon (a night for the Sun, a blackout for the Earth), in hours at the resolution of the sampling (6 h); a stretch that crosses the end of the year is cut. Regional (15 km cells): terrain smaller than a cell is invisible, so rough ground is overstated. Not validated against NASA illumination products.
